focus.title: 美国升级对华半导体设备出口管制，新增14nm以下制程限制
focus.summary: 美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）于7月22日发布最终规则，进一步扩大对华半导体制造设备的出口管制范围，将14nm及以下制程的刻蚀、沉积、清洗等设备纳入许可证要求。该规则还扩大了外国直接产品规则（FDPR）的适用，限制美国技术含量超过0%的海外设备对华出口。企业需立即审查供应链中涉及美系技术的设备采购合同，评估合规风险。
focus.title_en: US Tightens Export Controls on Semiconductor Equipment, Adding 14nm and Below Restrictions
focus.summary_en: On July 22, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued a final rule expanding export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China, requiring licenses for equipment used in 14nm and below processes, including etching, deposition, and cleaning tools. The rule also extends the Foreign Direct Product Rule (FDPR) to cover overseas equipment with more than 0% U.S. technology content. Companies should immediately review supply chain contracts involving U.S.-origin technology to assess compliance risks.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：中国企业与外方合资协议中“僵局条款”的有效性获确认
case.summary: 在一起涉及中国科技公司与新加坡合作伙伴的合资纠纷中，SIAC仲裁庭确认了协议中“僵局条款”的效力，认定一方在僵局期间单方出售资产的行为违反合同。仲裁庭裁定违约方赔偿另一方实际损失及预期利益共约1200万美元。该案提示中国企业：合资协议中应明确僵局解决机制（如买/卖期权、强制解散），避免单方行动引发违约。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC） · 2026年7月
case.title_en: SIAC Upholds 'Deadlock Clause' in Joint Venture Agreement Between Chinese Company and Foreign Partner
case.summary_en: In a dispute involving a Chinese tech company and its Singaporean partner, the SIAC tribunal upheld the validity of a 'deadlock clause' in the joint venture agreement, finding that the unilateral sale of assets by one party during a deadlock period constituted a breach. The tribunal awarded the aggrieved party approximately USD 12 million in actual losses and lost profits. This case reminds Chinese enterprises to clearly define deadlock resolution mechanisms (e.g., buy/sell options, forced dissolution) in JV agreements to avoid breach claims.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) · July 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”管理试点扩围，新增医疗与金融领域
policy.summary: 国家网信办与广东省政府联合发布公告，将大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”管理试点从原有的电子商务、制造业扩展至医疗健康、金融服务领域。符合条件的机构可免于数据出境安全评估，仅需履行备案义务。此举旨在促进大湾区生物医药研发、跨境支付等业务的数据合规流动，企业应尽快评估自身数据类别并申请纳入白名单。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室 · 2026.07.23
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Expands Cross-Border Data Flow 'White List' Pilot to Healthcare and Finance
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and the Guangdong provincial government jointly announced the expansion of the cross-border data flow 'white list' pilot in the Greater Bay Area from e-commerce and manufacturing to healthcare and financial services. Eligible entities are exempt from data export security assessments and only need to fulfill filing obligations. This move aims to facilitate compliant data flow for biomedical R&D and cross-border payments. Companies should promptly assess their data categories and apply for white list inclusion.

analysis.title: 中企应对欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的合规准备与成本测算
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进口商需购买CBAM证书。中国企业向欧盟出口钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢产品，应尽快完成产品碳足迹核算、建立碳排放数据管理体系，并与欧盟进口商协同填报季度报告。建议提前通过第三方认证机构进行碳核查，避免因数据不实导致高额罚款。预计每吨碳排放成本约60-80欧元，企业需纳入出口定价模型。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Compliance Preparation and Cost Estimation for Chinese Enterprises under EU CBAM
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU CBAM transitional period ends in late 2026, and from 2027 importers must purchase CBAM certificates. Chinese exporters of steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, electricity, and hydrogen to the EU should promptly calculate product carbon footprints, establish carbon emission data management systems, and collaborate with EU importers to submit quarterly reports. It is advisable to obtain carbon verification from accredited third-party bodies to avoid hefty penalties for inaccurate data. Estimated carbon cost is around €60-80 per ton, which should be factored into export pricing models.
